company.name: Menii
company.description_short: Menii is a digital menu and venue platform for hospitality businesses.
company.description_long: Menii helps venues manage menus, update content more easily, and present cleaner guest-facing digital menus.

core_problem: Menus are annoying to keep updated
PDFs and printed menus go out of date quickly
Small changes like prices or specials should be easy to publish

notes: Menii is focused on hospitality venues.
Menii is being built with a practical MVP-first approach.
Internal admin-led onboarding is part of the current operating model.

features_live_or_current_focus: menu imports from menu files/images with AI-assisted extraction
roadmap_or_exploration: QR code flows for venues and tables
wifi QR and venue engagement ideas
